note: Ranges are npm semver comparator sets exactly as published. severity is the reviewed GitHub Advisory Database value where present; maintainer_severity is the value on the repository advisory. Refresh this file before every audit older than 30 days.

advisories.summary: Svelte devalue: DoS via malformed input
advisories.condition: devalue.parse called on untrusted data.

advisories.summary: SvelteKit: ReDoS (O(n^2)) in content negotiation , unauthenticated DoS via the Accept header
advisories.condition: Any app; crafted Accept header causes CPU exhaustion when platform header-length limits are raised or absent.

advisories.summary: SvelteKit: Prototype pollution in file input deletion path in remote-function forms
advisories.condition: Uses remote form functions with a file input and accepts user-controlled field path names.

advisories.summary: SvelteKit: Big remote form function payloads can cause Node process to crash
advisories.condition: Uses remote form functions; very large payloads can crash the Node process.

advisories.summary: @sveltejs/kit: `query.batch` cross-talk
advisories.condition: Uses query.batch; rare timing can merge concurrent requests from different users (cross-user data disclosure).

advisories.summary: Svelte: SSR XSS via Insecure Promise Serialization in hydratable
advisories.condition: Uses experimental hydratable with attacker-controlled input where a synchronous value is hydrated, then a promise value.

advisories.summary: Svelte Vulnerable to XSS via DOM Clobbering of Internal Framework State
advisories.condition: Attribute spreading on a form element plus spreading or a dynamic name on an input or button inside it, both user-controllable.

advisories.summary: Svelte: ReDoS in `<svelte:element>` Tag Validation
advisories.condition: svelte:element with a tag of unconstrained length.

advisories.summary: Svelte devalue: DoS via sparse array deserialization
advisories.condition: devalue.parse called on untrusted data (sparse arrays).

advisories.summary: Svelte SSR vulnerable to cross-site scripting via spread attributes
advisories.condition: Spreads user-controlled or external data as element attributes (SSR); event handler props reach HTML.

advisories.summary: @sveltejs/kit: Unvalidated redirect in handle hook causes Denial-of-Service
advisories.condition: Calls redirect() inside the handle hook with a location containing characters invalid in an HTTP header, worst when the location is user input.

advisories.summary: @sveltejs/adapter-node has a BODY_SIZE_LIMIT bypass
advisories.condition: Runs on adapter-node and relies on BODY_SIZE_LIMIT (chunked requests could bypass it). Limits enforced at WAF, gateway, or platform are unaffected.

advisories.summary: Sveltejs devalue's `devalue.parse` and `devalue.unflatten` emit objects with `__proto__` own properties
advisories.condition: Downstream code merges devalue.parse output with Object.assign or similar.

advisories.summary: devalue has prototype pollution in devalue.parse and devalue.unflatten
advisories.condition: devalue.parse or unflatten on untrusted data.

advisories.summary: SvelteKit  has deserialization expansion in unvalidated `form` remote function leading to Denial of Service (experimental only)
advisories.condition: experimental.remoteFunctions plus form, and processes the files array without checking count or size.

advisories.summary: Svelte: XSS via HTML Comment Injection in SSR Error Boundary Hydration Markers
advisories.condition: Attacker-controlled content returned from transformError (error boundaries).

advisories.summary: Svelte vulnerable to XSS during SSR with contenteditable `bind:innerText` and `bind:textContent`
advisories.condition: contenteditable with bind:innerText or bind:textContent initialised from untrusted data on the server.

advisories.summary: CPU exhaustion in SvelteKit remote form deserialization (experimental only)
advisories.condition: experimental.remoteFunctions plus form.

advisories.summary: Memory exhaustion in SvelteKit remote form deserialization (experimental only)
advisories.condition: experimental.remoteFunctions plus form.

advisories.summary: devalue affected by CPU and memory amplification from sparse arrays
advisories.condition: Sparse arrays reach uneval or stringify on the server (hard to exploit).

advisories.summary: devalue `uneval`ed code can create objects with polluted prototypes when `eval`ed
advisories.condition: uneval of untrusted data that is later evaluated.

advisories.summary: Svelte SSR attribute spreading includes inherited properties from prototype chain
advisories.condition: SSR attribute spreading when Object.prototype is already polluted elsewhere.

advisories.summary: Svelte SSR does not validate dynamic element tag names in `<svelte:element>`
advisories.condition: svelte:element this={tag} with an untrusted tag string (SSR).

advisories.summary: Svelte affected by cross-site scripting via spread attributes in Svelte SSR
advisories.condition: Spreads untrusted data as element attributes during SSR.

advisories.summary: Svelte affected by XSS in SSR `<option>` element
advisories.condition: SSR of an option element whose content is untrusted.

advisories.summary: Cache poisoning in @sveltejs/adapter-vercel
advisories.condition: Deployed with adapter-vercel; an internal ISR query parameter on all routes lets an attacker get user-specific responses cached for others. Victim must click an attacker link while signed in.

advisories.summary: svelte is vulnerable to XSS with textarea bind:value
advisories.condition: Svelte 3 SSR textarea bind:value filled by user content.

advisories.summary: devalue vulnerable to denial of service due to memory/CPU exhaustion in devalue.parse
advisories.condition: devalue.parse on untrusted data (ArrayBuffer hydration).

advisories.summary: svelte vulnerable to Cross-site Scripting
advisories.condition: hydratable keys built from untrusted input.

advisories.summary: @sveltejs/kit has memory amplification DoS vulnerability in Remote Functions binary form deserializer (application/x-sveltekit-formdata)
advisories.condition: Uses the experimental form remote function (binary application/x-sveltekit-formdata payload).

advisories.summary: Devalue is vulnerable to denial of service due to memory exhaustion in devalue.parse
advisories.condition: devalue.parse on untrusted data (typed array hydration).

advisories.summary: SvelteKit is vulnerable to denial of service and possible SSRF when using prerendering
advisories.condition: At least one prerendered route (DoS from 2.44.0). DoS plus SSRF from 2.19.0 when also on adapter-node without ORIGIN set and without a proxy that validates Host.

advisories.summary: SvelteKit is vulnerable to denial of service and possible SSRF when using prerendering
advisories.condition: At least one prerendered route (DoS from 2.44.0). DoS plus SSRF from 2.19.0 when also on adapter-node without ORIGIN set and without a proxy that validates Host.

advisories.summary: devalue prototype pollution vulnerability
advisories.condition: devalue.parse on untrusted data with __proto__ keys.

advisories.summary: @sveltejs/kit vulnerable to Cross-site Scripting via tracked search_params
advisories.condition: A server load function iterates over all entries of event.url.searchParams.

advisories.summary: @sveltejs/kit vulnerable to XSS on dev mode 404 page
advisories.condition: Dev server only (dev mode 404 page).

advisories.summary: @sveltejs/kit has unescaped error message included on error page
advisories.condition: App passes user-controlled content into error() messages that reach the static error.html fallback.

advisories.summary: Svelte has a potential mXSS vulnerability due to improper HTML escaping
advisories.condition: Svelte 4 SSR attribute escaping (mXSS) with untrusted values.

advisories.summary: Sending a GET or HEAD request with a body crashes SvelteKit
advisories.condition: adapter-node or preview; a GET or HEAD request with a body crashes the server.

advisories.summary: Sending a GET or HEAD request with a body crashes SvelteKit
advisories.condition: adapter-node or preview; a GET or HEAD request with a body crashes the server.

advisories.summary: Sending a GET or HEAD request with a body crashes SvelteKit
advisories.condition: adapter-node or preview; a GET or HEAD request with a body crashes the server.

advisories.summary: Sending a GET or HEAD request with a body crashes SvelteKit
advisories.condition: adapter-node or preview; a GET or HEAD request with a body crashes the server.

advisories.summary: SvelteKit framework has Insufficient CSRF protection for CORS requests
advisories.condition: SvelteKit 1 CSRF check bypass with upper-cased Content-Type.

advisories.summary: SvelteKit vulnerable to Cross-Site Request Forgery
advisories.condition: SvelteKit 1 CSRF check bypass with a different Content-Type (text/plain, PUT, PATCH, DELETE).

advisories.summary: Svelte vulnerable to XSS when using objects during server-side rendering
advisories.condition: Svelte 3 SSR with objects in attributes.

advisories.summary: Malformed null-prototype object keys bypass __proto__ rejection via property-key coercion
advisories.condition: devalue.parse on untrusted data; defensive fix, very unlikely to matter.
advisories.source: repository-advisory (not yet in reviewed GitHub Advisory DB on 2026-09-30)

advisories.summary: stringifyAsync can cause an unhandled rejection despite a caught returned promise
advisories.condition: stringifyAsync with request-influenced promise timing; mostly a developer bug.
advisories.source: repository-advisory (not yet in reviewed GitHub Advisory DB on 2026-09-30)

advisories.summary: Custom ArrayBuffer revivers can bypass typed-array allocation validation
advisories.condition: parse with a malformed custom ArrayBuffer reviver.
advisories.source: repository-advisory (not yet in reviewed GitHub Advisory DB on 2026-09-30)

advisories.summary: Sparse arrays emitted by uneval cause eager allocation when evaluated
advisories.condition: Evaluating uneval output of very large sparse arrays.
advisories.source: repository-advisory (not yet in reviewed GitHub Advisory DB on 2026-09-30)

advisories.summary: Repeated primitive strings cause quadratic expansion in uneval
advisories.condition: Data parsed then passed to uneval.
advisories.source: repository-advisory (not yet in reviewed GitHub Advisory DB on 2026-09-30)

advisories.summary: Residual sparse-array CPU amplification in uneval
advisories.condition: Attacker-influenced sparse values passed to uneval.
advisories.source: repository-advisory (not yet in reviewed GitHub Advisory DB on 2026-09-30)

advisories.summary: `stringify`/`uneval` serialize shared memory
advisories.condition: A server load (or other serialised data) returns a Node Buffer or typed array; up to 64 KB of shared process memory, including other users request data, can be shipped to the client.
advisories.source: repository-advisory (not yet in reviewed GitHub Advisory DB on 2026-09-30)
